description: The verification set: wild-type and perturbed behaviours that an augmented network must keep. Used inside the repair loop. Disjoint from the held-out set (data/heldout), which only scores the final networks.
source: Gupta S, Panda PK, Silveira DA, Ahuja R, Hashimoto RF. Cells 2023;12(7):1085, doi 10.3390/cells12071085: Section 3.2, Figure 3 and Table 1. The expected phenotypes are the ones that paper reports for its own model; the base network reproduces all of them (tests/test_phenotypes.py).
notes: A perturbation sets nodes to 0 (knock-out) or 1 (E1, gain of function). exact means the set of phenotypes over all fixed points must equal the listed set; covers means it must contain it. g2_arrest is the readout of docs/heldout_protocol.md (Cdc2_CycB off while DNA_damage is on); its expectation is the base network's own wild-type behaviour, kept as a regression constraint, not a literature fact.
